units.source_text: 他口上虽不明言，但脸上逐渐显露怨恨之色，因此大女公子颇觉为难。

en.t: Although he did not say it plainly, resentment gradually showed on his face, and this put the elder princess in considerable difficulty.

units.source_text: 同他随意谈话，越发感到痛苦了。

en.t: Talking with him casually only made her feel more and more distressed.

units.source_text: 然而大体说来，薰君毕竟是个深通情理的好人，

en.t: Yet generally speaking, Kaoru was, after all, a good man who deeply understood feeling and reason,

units.source_text: 所以大女公子对待他也并不十分冷淡，终于和他会面了。

en.t: so the elder princess did not treat him with complete coldness, and at last she met with him.

units.source_text: 她叫人把自己所居的佛堂与薰君所居的客间之间的门打开，

en.t: She had someone open the door between the Buddhist chapel where she stayed and the guest room where Kaoru was lodged,

units.source_text: 在佛前点起明灯，又在帘子旁边添置一个屏风。

en.t: lit a bright lamp before the Buddha, and set an additional screen beside the curtain.

units.source_text: 叫人在客间里也点起灯来。

en.t: She also had a lamp lit in the guest room.

units.source_text: 但薰君不要点灯，他说：

en.t: But Kaoru did not want the lamp lit, and he said:

units.source_text: “我心中烦恼，不能顾到礼貌，光线不要太亮。”

en.t: “My heart is troubled, and I cannot attend properly to courtesy; please do not make the light too bright.”

units.source_text: 便将身子躺下。

en.t: Then he lay down.

units.source_text: 侍女们随意不拘地拿出些果物来请他吃，

en.t: The ladies in waiting, in an easy and informal manner, brought out some fruit and offered it to him,

units.source_text: 又拿出精美的酒肴来招待他的随从人员。

en.t: and they also brought out fine wine and dishes to entertain his attendants.

units.source_text: 侍女们群集在廊下等处，离开主客二人所居之处甚远。

en.t: The ladies gathered in the corridor and elsewhere, staying well away from the place where the host and guest were seated.

units.source_text: 二人就悄悄地谈起话来。

en.t: The two of them then began to speak quietly together.

units.source_text: 大女公子态度虽不十分融洽，却甚温柔妩媚。

en.t: Although the elder princess was not entirely at ease in her manner, she was very gentle and charming.

units.source_text: 其娇声细语，深深地牵惹了薰君的心，

en.t: Her delicate voice and soft words deeply drew Kaoru’s heart toward her,

units.source_text: 使得他焦灼难堪，也可谓荒唐之至了。

en.t: leaving him so tormented with longing that it could truly be called utterly unreasonable.

units.source_text: 他时时在想：

en.t: From time to time he thought:

units.source_text: “这点毫不足道的阻隔，成了我们中间的障碍物，叫我忍受焦灼之苦。

en.t: “This trivial barrier has become an obstacle between us, forcing me to endure the pain of restless longing.

units.source_text: 我如此缺乏勇气，实在太愚笨了。”

en.t: For me to lack courage so badly is truly foolish.”

units.source_text: 然而外表装作无事，只管纵谈一般世间的事情：

en.t: Yet outwardly he pretended that nothing was wrong and simply went on talking freely about ordinary worldly matters:

units.source_text: 可悲的、可喜的，以及种种富有趣味的事。

en.t: sad things, happy things, and all sorts of interesting affairs.
